mission.title: Bombs and Betrayal
mission.description: Information decoded from captured PDA devices has uncovered a plot by the imposter Agents to detonate a large bomb somewhere in the City, most likely at an important target such as a hardline junction or subway station. You will follow one of our leads in an attempt to foil this plot.

npc.say: I can't talk with these imposter Agents around!
I hope you can take those imposters out, 'cause if you don't they'll be coming back for me.

You have my thanks. I must say, it is refreshing to see humans working hand-in-hand with the Machines. I'm too old to overcome a certain...prejudice against them, but perhaps a new generation... Perhaps you can humanize them, even if you can't trust them. After all, did not Neo implant some of his personality in their Agent Smith? Well, enough history; I wish you well. As for myself, I have some building and exploring to do. Perhaps we'll meet again some day.
You certainly trashed a whole lot of those imposter Agents back there. I was rooting for you.
You've been cleared to go through... but if it was up to me, we wouldn't give clearance to anyone working for those damn Machines.
We know that bomb isn't armed, but that's fine--we don't mean to use it as a weapon, anyway.
Don't you worry--we'll be out of here long before your Machine buddies can break through our local defenses.
Morpheus doesn't talk to just anyone, so consider yourself lucky.

phase.briefing: Information decoded from captured PDA devices has uncovered a plot by the imposter Agents to detonate a large bomb somewhere in the City, most likely at an important target such as a hardline junction or subway station. You will follow one of our leads in an attempt to foil this plot.

enter.say: The Exile gang at this location has had access to complex high explosives in the past and has recently been gathering materials that could be used to manufacture a substantial bomb. Additionally, surveillance cameras have recorded members of the gang conversing with imposter agents on several occasions. Investigate the gang's hideout and look for evidence of bomb-manufacturing activity that could lead us to the imposters.
There's an alarm system in this room... must be something important in here.

done.say: Ah, notes about a bomb manufacturing facility. That could be what we're looking for. Leave the area and upload the notes at a hardline, operative.

objective.text: Upload the notes at a hardline

phase.briefing: The notes describe an illicit bomb factory nearby. Proceed to the area and investigate.

enter.say: The Exiles' bomb factory should be in that building. Look for a large explosive device, and keep an eye out for any evidence linking it to the imposter Agents.
Ah. I think you have found evidence of imposter Agent involvement, operative.

talk.say: I can't talk with these imposter Agents around!
Hm. That Exile may know where the bomb is located. Destroy all of the imposters in the area, then question Connor Higley again.

objective.text: Destroy all of the imposters in the area

done.say: You have destroyed all of the imposter Agents in the area, operative. Now question Connor Higley about the bomb.

objective.text: Get the Large Bomb from Connor Higley

talk.say: Okay, now that there are no imposters around to overhear... They were forcing me to make a large bomb for them. I've got the bomb and a map disk showing where it was going to be delivered. You seem like you're an enemy of the imposters, so why don't you take them?

objective.text: Get the Map Disk from Connor Higley

done.say: Good. Now upload that Map Disk at a hardline so that we can trace the bomb's delivery site.

objective.text: Upload the Map Disk at a hardline

phase.briefing: This appears to be a very large scale operation by the imposters. We will give you some additional combat assistance before we send you to the bomb delivery location. Report to the waypoint location.

enter.say: You will find two of our Agents here: Agent Brown and Agent West. They have been assigned to assist you. Lead them out of the area and await further orders.

talk.say: We do not usually take orders from... humans.

objective.text: Lead Agent Brown and Agent West out of the area

phase.briefing: Good. I am uploading the bomb delivery address to you now. Take Agent Brown and Agent West there with you.

enter.say: Sensors indicate a very large number of imposter Agents inside that building. This is probably the group that was going to carry out the bombing. Eliminate all of them.
The far door is sealed by a computer-controlled electromagnetic lock. Maybe some of the computers in the area can control it.

objective.text: Eliminate all of the imposter Agents

done.say: Looks like you disabled the electromagnetic door lock.

complete.say: Impressive work, {player}. Now, leave the area and prepare for further orders. Something... interesting has come up.
Perhaps this will convince the imposters that their current course is a foolish one.

phase.briefing: We have received a coded transmission over a secure channel that was established for high-level communications with the Zion leadership at the time of the Truce. Whoever is behind the transmission requests that you take the imposter's bomb to them. This is not a significant security risk as Connor Higley did not complete or arm the bomb before he gave it to you. We are willing to risk the relatively useless bomb in order to find out who is using this channel, and what it is that they want. Proceed.

enter.say: The coded transmission directed you to deliver the bomb to operatives in that building. Viral jamming is preventing our sensors from scanning the building, so stay alert and find out who they are and what they want.

talk.say: Well, well, well. Morpheus, at last. Watch yourself, human--his unpredictability makes him somewhat dangerous. And yet it is fascinating to watch his reactions to stimuli.

Your arrival is very welcome. I am Morpheus, once a Captain of Zion, and now...well, perhaps you could think of me as unemployed. Although you have allied yourself with the Machines--and I must warn you, you can only trust a machine so far--I believe that we share common...hopes for this world: peace in the City, for instance. Speaking of which, we monitored your battle against the imposter programs, and I must commend you on your victory. Do you have their bomb with you?
Give him the bomb, operative. He is hardly likely to use it against the City, as that would harm his precious humans. We are interested to see what he does with it.

objective.text: Give the defunct Large Bomb to the Zion contact

done.say: You would be wise to respect my experience, and give the imposters' bomb into my keeping. I promise you, I will not use it as a weapon. I have certain other uses for its component code.
Your mission is complete, operative. However, you may wish to goad Morpheus into talking further. Perhaps he will reveal more of his plans.

mission.finish: That was an interesting conversation, to say the least. It is tempting to capture Morpheus now, but perhaps the time is not yet ripe. I think that he inadvertently revealed more about his plans than he meant to--we shall see. Thank you for your efforts today, {player}; you have impressed us.
